ui.docsTagline: 简明的分步指南，涵盖 Mica 的每项功能。
ui.overviewIntro: 从边栏中选择一个主题，或从以下方面开始。
ui.inApp: 这些指南也可在 App 中查看：设置 → 关于 → 功能。
ui.agentsIntro: 将 Claude、Cursor、Codex 或任何 MCP 客户端连接到 Mac 上的 Mica，让智能体为你创建、编辑和导出看板。

features.title: 创建你的第一张参考板
features.summary: 参考板是用于存放参考素材和设计的无限画布。每张参考板可包含多个页面，每个页面都有自己的图层。
steps: 在素材库中，轻点“新建参考板”（在 Mac 上按 ⌘N）。
为参考板命名，然后选择“空白参考板”或选取一个模板。
使用“添加”→“文件”、粘贴或将其拖到画布上来添加参考素材。
选择任意内容，即可在检查器中查看其属性。使用“缩放以适合”可查看整张参考板。
随时打开“帮助”→“重播画布导览”，快速了解画布。

faq.q: 参考板数量有限制吗？
faq.a: 免费方案对参考板数量和每张参考板的项目数量都有限制。Mica Pro 会取消这两项限制。当某项操作需要 Pro 时，Mica 会提示你。

faq.q: 我的参考板存储在哪里？
faq.a: 存储在此设备上的 Mica 素材库中。打开 iCloud 后，素材库还会同步到你的其他设备。

features.why: A board is where every reference, sketch and design for one project lives. Start a new board when a project, a client or a study needs its own space, and add pages when one board needs several separate canvases.
uses: Start a blank board for a character and drop in every pose, costume and color reference you collect.
Begin a client brief from a template so the structure is already in place.
Keep one board per App Store release and build each screenshot on its own page.
Open a board on your iPad while sketching, then continue on your Mac.

details.text: In the library, the create menu offers Blank Board and New Board from Template…. On Mac, ⌘N creates a board and ⇧⌘N opens a new window.
Also in the create menu. Opens .refboard archives as new boards. Importing boards is a Mica Pro feature.
Settings → Defaults sets the view new boards open in: Infinite Canvas, Grid or List. You can switch any board’s view later.

details.term: Default Canvas Background and Default Canvas Grid
details.text: Settings → Canvas sets the background and grid new boards start with.

The free plan includes one board, one page per board and 12 items per board. Mica Pro removes these limits. Without Pro, your three oldest boards stay open; others show as locked but are kept and keep syncing.
In the Help menu and in Quick Actions. Replays the short canvas tour on the open board. The tour respects Reduce Motion.
Boards appear in Spotlight search, except private ones. An open board that isn’t private is offered to your other devices through Handoff.

tips: Name boards after the project, not the date. Search and Spotlight work on board names.
Use pages for stages of one project, and separate boards for separate projects.
Set Default View to Grid if you mostly collect and browse references rather than lay them out.
Press ⌘/ on any board to search for a command when you don’t know where it lives.

hero.alt: A Mica board on iPad with character references spread across the infinite canvas

features.title: 导入和采集参考素材
features.summary: 几乎可从任何地方导入图像、GIF、WebP 动画、视频、PDF 和 SVG，或将灵感存入采集收件箱，稍后再整理。
steps: 打开一张参考板，然后选择“添加”→“文件”、“照片与视频”、“拍照”或“扫描”。
也可以从 Finder 或其他 App 拖入文件，或将图像或 SVG 粘贴到画布上。
在其他 App 中，使用共享表单并选择“添加到 Mica”。在 Mac 上，可将文件拖放到“菜单栏快速投放”。
未选取参考板就采集的项目会进入素材库中的采集收件箱。打开它，为每个项目选择一张参考板。
要在另一张参考板上重复使用图像，请从“素材”中添加。Mica 只保留一份原始文件。

faq.q: 同一张图像导入两次会存储两份吗？
faq.a: 不会。打开“导入时检测重复项”（“设置”→“数据”）后，Mica 会重复使用已有的原始文件。

faq.q: SVG 会作为图片导入吗？
faq.a: 不会。粘贴或拖放的 SVG 会成为可编辑的矢量图层，置于与 SVG 尺寸相同的画框中。

faq.q: 可以添加网页吗？
faq.a: 可以。选择“添加”→“网页链接”，即可在参考板上放置链接卡片。

features.why: References are only useful when they are on the board. Mica takes files from the file picker, Photos, the camera, drag and drop, the clipboard, the share sheet and the Mac menu bar, and stores each original once so you can reuse it anywhere.
uses: Drag a folder of pose photos from Finder onto a board in one move.
Share an image from Safari or Photos to Mica on iPhone without opening the app.
Copy several frames from a PDF viewer and paste them as separate items.
Back up a set of boards as .refboard files and drop them on Home on another Mac.

details.text: Photos & Videos…, Files…, Web Link… and, on iPhone and iPad, Take Photo… and Scan…. Web Link… places a link card on the board.
Drop files from Finder, Files or another app onto the canvas. Several files are placed in a centered grid with 24 points between them. Images keep their native pixel size.

Pasting checks for media before text. Several copied images, GIFs, WebP, videos or PDFs each become their own item and keep their original format. On Mac, files copied in Finder are imported as files. Text becomes a note or link only when the clipboard holds no media.
Pasted or dropped SVGs, including Copy as SVG from Figma or Illustrator, become editable vector layers inside an unfilled frame sized to the SVG, in one undo step.
Items captured without a board, for example from the share sheet, wait in Capture Inbox in the library sidebar (the Inbox tab on iPhone) until you choose a board for them.
Turn it on in Settings → General. Choose a destination board, then drop files on the menu bar icon from any app.
Settings → Data → Import. When on, a file whose content matches an existing original reuses that original instead of storing a second copy. Preserve Original Filenames keeps each file’s name.

Drop any number of .refboard archives on Home. Each one becomes a new board, with one progress message and a list of any files that failed. Images dropped in the same drop become one new board. Board import is a Mica Pro feature and counts toward the board limit.

In the Fonts screen of the library. Takes many .ttf, .otf, .ttc and .otc files and whole folders, searched recursively, by picker or by drag and drop. Up to 2,000 files per import and 40 MB per file. Duplicate files are skipped, and a message reports how many were added, already present or unreadable.
Every import path counts toward the 12-item limit per board on the free plan. Adding folders to the canvas is a Mica Pro feature.

tips: Leave Detect Duplicates on Import on. Re-importing a reference then costs no extra storage.
Drop a batch of files at once instead of one by one. Mica lays them out in a tidy grid for you.
Use Capture Inbox for quick saves on the go, then sort everything in one sitting.
Paste SVG from your design tool instead of exporting a PNG, so the shapes stay editable.
To reuse an image on another board, add it from Assets rather than importing the file again.

hero.alt: Sharing a photo from another app straight to a Mica board page on iPhone

features.title: 整理素材库
features.summary: 使用文件夹、标签、收藏、搜索和颜色筛选，让参考板和素材井井有条。
steps: 在素材库边栏中选择“新建文件夹”，然后将参考板拖入其中。
长按（或右键点按）参考板，即可重命名、收藏、更换封面、移动或将其设为私密。
打开“素材”查看所有原始文件。可按名称或标签搜索，或按主色筛选。
使用“最近项目”和“收藏”快速回到当前的工作。删除的参考板会移到废纸篓，直到你清倒废纸篓。

faq.q: 可以在 Mica 之外找到参考板吗？
faq.a: 可以。除私密参考板外，参考板都会出现在 Spotlight 搜索中。

faq.q: 如何添加标签？
faq.a: 选择一个参考素材并在检查器中打开“详情”，或使用画布上的标签按钮。

features.why: As boards and references pile up, the library keeps them findable. Folders, tags, favorites and color search let you get back to any board or asset in a few seconds.
uses: Keep one folder per client and favorite the boards you are working on this week.
Find every warm, orange reference across all your boards with the color filter in Assets.
Hide personal study boards behind Make Private.
Keep a shared set of brand fonts in the Fonts screen and use them on any board.

details.text: All Boards, Recents, Favorites, Capture Inbox, Assets, Templates, Fonts, Models, your folders and tags, Trash and Settings. On iPhone, the tabs are Home, Inbox, Assets and Settings; Assets has Assets, Templates and Fonts pages.
Long-press or right-click a board for Rename…, Favorite, Make Private, Move to Folder, Default Page, Change Cover…, Duplicate, Export Board…, Save as Template… and Versions….
Choose which page a board opens on: Last Opened Page, or a specific page.
Pick the cover shown on the board’s card. Reset to Automatic goes back to the generated cover.
Every original file in your library, once. Search by name or tag, or filter by color to show only assets with that color among their dominant colors.

One row per family, drawn in its own face, with the style count and an editable sample line. Search, multi-select, and Remove from Library. Removing a font never removes it from boards that already use it.

The canvas font picker has a Font Library section between In This Board and All Fonts. Picking a family copies that family into the board, in one undo step, so the board carries only the fonts it uses.
Deleted boards wait in Trash until you empty it.

Board and folder cards sit on a glass surface with a soft shadow so they stand out from the window. With Reduce Transparency on, they use a solid surface. The New Board card is always the same height as the boards beside it.

tips: Set a Default Page on boards with many pages so they always open where the real work is.
Tag references by subject, not by project. Tags then work across every board.
Use the color filter in Assets to build a palette board from references you already own.
Keep brand fonts in the Fonts screen. A board sent as .refboard still carries the fonts it uses.

features.title: 从模板开始
features.summary: 模板为你提供现成的参考板：研究布局、情绪板、故事板，以及包含可替换字段的 App Store 截屏套件。
steps: 在素材库或“新建参考板”菜单中，选择“从模板新建参考板…”。
浏览各个类别，打开模板进行预览。
选择“使用模板”。Mica 会创建一张新参考板，其中包含可编辑的画框、文本和图像占位框。
将图像拖放到占位框中即可填充；占位框会按其形状裁剪图像。
要创建自己的模板，请在参考板、页面或所选画框上选择“存为模板…”。

faq.q: 使用模板需要 Pro 吗？
faq.a: 使用模板是 Mica Pro 功能。你可以免费预览所有模板。

faq.q: Apple 截屏展示包含哪些内容？
faq.a: 共五个页面，每台设备一页，每页包含十个按 App Store 顺序排列、符合 Apple 规定尺寸的画框，以及说明文字和截屏字段。

features.why: Templates save you from rebuilding the same structure for every project. Each one is an ordinary board of frames, text, image wells and guides that you can change freely.
uses: Start a figure study with Figure & Pose Composition and drop references into its wells.
Build a full App Store screenshot set at Apple’s sizes with Apple Screenshot Showcase.
Save your own client brief layout as a template and reuse it for each new client.
Capture one frame of a finished design as a template for the next screen.

details.text: Blank Reference Board, Figure & Pose Composition, Character Design Sheet, Environment & Worldbuilding, Painting: Value & Color Study, Animation & Motion Study, Storyboard & Shot Planning, Tattoo / Client Brief, Portrait & Costume Study, App Store Screenshot Set and Apple Screenshot Showcase.

Shows the template’s pages and layers. You can hide layers for the preview only, and pan and zoom the page from 50% to 400%. Nothing is editable in the preview. Create Board builds it with the name you enter.

Masked image fields shaped for what they hold. Drop one PNG or JPEG under 50 MB onto a well to fill it; the image is cropped to fill the shape in one undo step. Select a well’s placeholder for Choose Image… and Use Image from Page.
Capture Scope: Entire Board, one page, or one frame and its contents. Captured pages and frames become independent template boards. Add a name, description and category.

Structure Only turns reference placements into editable prompt cards and leaves out original files and source URLs. Include References copies the original files into the template, after you confirm you may keep and share them.
In the library’s create menu. Adds a template file someone shared with you.
You can preview every template for free. Creating boards from templates and saving or importing templates need Mica Pro.

tips: Use Structure Only when you share a template, so you never pass on images you don’t own.
Fill wells by dropping images straight onto them. The crop and study settings are already set.
Templates keep guides on a locked Construction Guides layer. Unlock that layer only when you want to move them.
Save a polished frame as a template rather than duplicating old boards. You start clean every time.

features.title: 平移和缩放画布
features.summary: 在任意大小的参考板上自由移动，从 0.2% 的全局概览到近距离的细节。
steps: 在触控板或触摸屏上用两指平移。在 Mac 上，也可以滚动，或按住空格键并拖移。
双指开合进行缩放，或按 ⌘+ 和 ⌘−。按住 Option 键或 Command 键并滚动鼠标滚轮也可缩放。
使用缩放菜单中的“缩放以适合”、“缩放至所选内容”和“实际大小”。
使用角落中的小地图跳转到参考板的其他部分。
按 ⌘\ 隐藏画布控制项，选择“显示界面”可重新显示。

faq.q: 最多可以缩小到多少？
faq.a: 0.2%。低于 1% 时，缩放读数会显示一位小数。

faq.q: 缩放感觉太快或太慢。
faq.a: 在“设置”→“画布”→“导航”中更改“触控板缩放速度”和“滚动缩放速度”。

faq.q: 可以在另一台设备上继续吗？
faq.a: 可以。“接力”会将打开的参考板提供给登录同一 Apple 账户的其他设备。

features.why: Boards grow large fast. Mica’s camera moves smoothly with trackpad, mouse, touch and keyboard, so you can go from a full-board overview to a single detail and back without losing your place.
uses: Zoom out to see a whole mood board, then zoom to one frame with Zoom to Selection.
Save views of the areas you visit often and jump between them as Saved Regions.
Hide every control with ⌘\ to see the board clean while presenting.
Flick through a long storyboard with one finger on iPad and let it coast.

details.text: From 0.2% to 6,400%. Below 1% the zoom readout shows one decimal.

⌘+ and ⌘− (⌘↑ and ⌘↓ on iPad) zoom about the pointer when it is over the canvas, otherwise about the center. Holding a key zooms in one continuous motion. ⇧1 or ⌘0 zooms to fit, ⇧2 zooms to the selection, and ⇧0 or ⌘1 shows actual size.
The zoom percentage in the toolbar opens Zoom In, Zoom Out, Zoom to Fit, Zoom to Selection, Actual Size and Show Position Preview. Its buttons zoom about the center of the view.
Fits the selection in the clear canvas area. Also the crosshairs button in the selection menu’s header. A layer row’s menu has Zoom to Layer, which fits everything on that layer.

Two-finger scroll, one finger on touch, Space-drag on Mac, or the arrow keys when nothing is selected. A quick release keeps the canvas moving and slowing down, like a scroll view. A touch or click stops it. Pinching on iPad and iPhone keeps the content under both fingers.

details.term: Trackpad zoom speed and Scroll zoom speed
details.text: Settings → Canvas → Navigation. Trackpad zoom speed sets pinch zoom, from 10% to 150% (default 45%). Scroll zoom speed sets the mouse wheel and ⌥- or ⌘-scroll, from 25% to 300% (default 150%). Reset Zoom Speed restores both.
Settings → Display → Minimap: Always Show, Show While Navigating (default) or Hidden. The small overview fades in while you move and fades out shortly after. Drag in it to move the view.
The Regions button in the sidebar rail. Save This View remembers the page, position and zoom. Step through regions with Previous and Next, or use Update to Current View, Rename… and Delete.
With one frame or group selected, hides everything else on the page and zooms to it. Click the lightning-bolt button or press Esc to leave and return to your previous view.
⌘\ hides the canvas controls; Show UI brings them back. ⇧⌘\ shows or hides the sidebars.

tips: Point at the spot you want to inspect before pressing ⌘+. The zoom stays anchored there.
Use ⇧2 after selecting something in the Layers panel to jump straight to it.
Save a region for each area you return to on a big board, instead of zooming out and hunting.
If a mouse wheel zooms too slowly, raise Scroll zoom speed rather than scrolling more.
Use Hyperfocus to work on one screen of a crowded board without hiding layers by hand.

hero.alt: Panning around an infinite canvas of art references on iPhone

features.title: 选择图层
features.summary: 点按、按住 Shift 键点按或拖出选框即可选择。右键点按所选内容，即可使用所有适用的操作。
steps: 点按或轻点图层即可选择。按住 Shift 键点按可添加或移除图层。
在空白区域拖移以绘制选框。选框会选择它触及的最外层图层：无论完全框住还是只是跨越，触及的画框都会被单独选中。
在画框或编组内，连按两次可深入一层。按 Esc 键可退回上一层。
右键点按（或长按）所选内容，即可在指针处打开其菜单。
按 ⌘A 选择页面上的所有内容。

faq.q: 如何用选框选择画框内的图层？
faq.a: 从画框内部开始拖出选框。完全在画框内绘制的选框会在该画框的层级工作，因此会选择其中的内容而不是画框本身。

faq.q: 在 iPad 上可以用键盘选择吗？
faq.a: 可以。连接硬件键盘后，按住 Shift 键点按和按住 Command 键点按的用法与 Mac 上相同。

features.why: Almost every edit starts with a selection. Mica selects like Figma, so you can pick whole frames, step into groups, walk through siblings and grab matching layers without touching the Layers panel.
uses: Marquee across several screens to select the screens themselves, then arrange them in a row.
Press Return on a card frame to select everything inside it.
Select one title, then ⌥⌘A to select the same title in every copy of the card.
Tab through the buttons in a toolbar one by one to check each one.

details.text: Drag on empty canvas. The marquee selects the outermost layers it touches, edges included. Any frame it reaches is selected on its own, never together with its contents. Grouped layers come in as their group. Start the marquee inside a frame to select layers within that frame. Locked layers are skipped.
Shift-click or ⌘-click. On iPad this works with a hardware keyboard. In the Layers panel, ⌘-click toggles a row and Shift-click selects a range.
Double-click a group or frame to go one level deeper. Esc selects the parent, then deselects all. ⇧↩ selects the parent group.
With a frame or group selected, selects all of its direct children.
Steps through layers at the same level in Layers panel order. Groups count as one unit, the order wraps around, and hidden layers are skipped.
Adds every visible, unlocked layer of the same kind and name, under a parent of the same name at the same depth. Use it to select a repeated layer in every copy of a card or screen.
In Design Tools: Select Same Type, Select Same Source, Select Same Fill, Select Same Stroke, Select Same Font, Select Same Size, Select Same Effect and Select Same Style.
Right-click, two-finger click or long-press opens the selection menu inside the canvas, at the pointer. Clicking an unselected layer selects it first. Click outside or press Esc to close it.
Each selected frame, group or layer gets one outline. A W × H badge below the selection updates while you move or resize. Turn it off with Settings → Canvas → Editing → Show Selection Size.

tips: To select layers inside a frame, start the marquee inside the frame, or select the frame and press Return.
Use Tab instead of clicking when layers are small or overlap.
Name repeated layers consistently. Select Matching Layers relies on names.
Press Esc repeatedly to climb out of deep nesting one level at a time.

features.title: 移动、调整大小和旋转
features.summary: 自由拖移图层或设定精确数值。每个数字栏都支持数学运算和单位。
steps: 拖移图层即可移动。按住 Shift 键可沿单一轴向移动。
拖移角点或任意边缘即可调整大小。按住 Shift 键可保持比例。
拖移所选内容上方的圆形控制点即可旋转。
按箭头键可微移 1 点，按住 Shift 键并按箭头键可微移 10 点。
在检查器中输入 X、Y、W 或 H。数字栏支持 100/3、+10、*2、%、px 和 em。拖移栏位的标签可快速调整数值。

faq.q: 如何让多个图层大小相同？
faq.a: 选择这些图层，然后使用“排列”或“设计工具”中的“匹配宽度”、“匹配高度”或“统一大小”。

faq.q: “对齐到像素”有什么作用？
faq.a: 它会将所选内容的位置和大小调整到整数单位，使边缘保持清晰。

faq.q: 我不小心清空了某个栏位。
faq.a: 让栏位保持空白并按 Return 键，即可恢复之前的值。

features.why: Layout work needs both quick dragging and exact numbers. Mica lets you move, resize and rotate by hand, then finish with precise values, math and units in the inspector.
uses: Drag a photo roughly into place, then type its exact X and Y.
Make three cards the same width with Match Width.
Scale a button with the Scale tool so its corner radius, stroke and text grow with it.
Type 100/3 into W to split a row into thirds.

details.text: Drag to move. Hold Shift to move along one axis; only that axis snaps. Hold Control to ignore snapping.

Drag a corner or anywhere along an edge. Edges resize one axis. Hold Shift to keep proportions. Hold Option to resize from the center: the opposite side mirrors the one you drag. On touch, resizing from the center needs a hardware keyboard.
Arrow keys move the selection 1 point, Shift-arrow 10 points. A nudge that would jump past the parent’s center line stops on it; the next press continues.
Resizes in proportion and also scales strokes, corner radii, shadows, blurs and text. A frame scales its whole contents from its top-left. Choosing another tool turns it off.

Number fields accept 100/3, parentheses, +10 and *2 relative to the current value, px, pt, % of the parent frame, em (font size), rem (16) and vw/vh (outermost frame). Invalid or empty entries restore the previous value.
Drag a number field’s label to change its value. On Mac, hold Shift for 10× steps or Option for 0.1× steps. The whole drag is one undo step.
Up and Down step a focused number field by 1, Shift by 10, and apply at once.
The inspector shows the selection’s X, Y, W and H. Editing them moves or scales the whole selection. Rotation and opacity show Mixed when layers differ.

details.term: Match Width, Match Height, Match Size
details.text: In Arrange or Design Tools. Match the key object, or the frontmost layer when there is none. Each layer keeps its top-left, and images keep their proportions.

details.term: Round to Pixels and Resize to Fit
details.text: Round to Pixels moves every edge onto whole units. Resize to Fit (⌥⇧⌘R) fits selected frames to their visible contents.

tips: Use + and * in fields to change several layers by the same amount without doing the math.
Use % in W or H to size a layer relative to its frame.
Use the Scale tool, not a plain resize, when a component should look the same at a bigger size.
Run Round to Pixels before exporting UI so edges stay crisp.

features.title: 智能参考线、标尺和网格
features.summary: 拖移时对齐内容、测量间距，并添加参考线和布局网格以实现精确操作。
steps: 拖移图层。粉色智能参考线会显示与附近图层的对齐和等间距关系。
拖移时按住 Control 键，可在本次移动中忽略吸附。
按 ⌃R 显示标尺。从标尺拖出即可添加参考线；将其拖回标尺即可移除。
选择一个画框，然后在检查器中添加“布局网格”：分栏、分行或方格网格。按 ⌃G 显示或隐藏所有网格。
选中一个图层后，按住 Option 键并将指针指向另一个图层，即可测量距离。

faq.q: 参考线和网格会被导出吗？
faq.a: 不会。它们是工作辅助工具，绝不会出现在导出内容中。

faq.q: 如何关闭吸附？
faq.a: 使用“设置”→“画布”→“编辑”中的开关：“对齐到网格”、“对齐到项目边缘”和“对齐到像素网格”。

features.why: Precise layouts need reference lines. Smart guides help while you drag, rulers and guides mark fixed lines, and layout grids give frames columns and rows to snap to.
uses: Center a title in its frame by dragging until the Centered label appears.
Mark a safe area on a screenshot page with ruler guides.
Give a web frame a 12-column grid and snap content to it.
Make a badge snap only to one card with Snap To…, ignoring everything around it.

details.text: While you move or resize, edges and centers snap to nearby layers, guides and grid lines. Inside a frame or group, the parent is always a snap reference, even off screen. Tolerances stay the same at every zoom: 8 points for edges, 12 points for centers. A center wins over an edge at the same distance.

When the moving layer is exactly centered in its parent or snap target, a crosshair and a label appear: Centered, Centered Horizontally or Centered Vertically. Equal distances to the parent’s edges are labeled.
Snaps a layer to the midpoint between its neighbors, or to repeat an existing gap. Both equal gaps are drawn and labeled. This also works inside frames.

Right-click or long-press a selection. Pick on Canvas… makes the next layer you click the target (Esc cancels). Nearby Layers lists enclosing frames first, then the nearest layers. While a target is set, the selection snaps only to that target’s edges and center. Reset Snap Target goes back to normal snapping.
Show rulers along the top and side. The selection’s extent is highlighted. The corner square opens Show Guides, Lock Guides, Remove All Guides and Hide Rulers.

Drag from a ruler to add a guide. Guides snap to layer edges and centers and land on whole units. Drag a guide back onto its ruler to remove it. Double-click it, or right-click → Edit Position…, to type an exact value. Guides belong to the page and never export.

Select a frame, then Inspector → Layout Grid. Choose Columns, Rows or Grid, then count, type (Stretch, Left/Top, Center, Right/Bottom), width, margin or offset, gutter, color and opacity. Up to 16 grids per frame. ⌃G shows or hides all grids.
Settings → Canvas → Editing: Snap to Grid, Snap to Item Edges, Snap to Pixel Grid (off by default), Show Rulers, Show Guides and Show Layout Grids. Hold Control while dragging to skip snapping once.
With a layer selected, hold Option and point at another layer to see the gaps between them, or the insets when one contains the other. Works on Mac and on iPad with a pointer and keyboard.

tips: Turn on Lock Guides once your guides are set, so you don’t drag them by accident.
Use Snap To… when a crowded area keeps snapping to the wrong layer.
Turn on Snap to Pixel Grid for UI work and leave it off for loose reference boards.
Watch for the Centered label instead of eyeballing. It appears only at exact center.

features.title: 对齐和分布
features.summary: 一步即可将多个图层对齐或均匀分布。
steps: 选择两个或更多图层。
在检查器或“排列”菜单中选择一种对齐方式：左对齐、水平居中、右对齐、顶对齐、垂直居中或底对齐。
要与某个图层对齐，请再次点按该图层，使其成为关键对象。它会保持不动，其他图层随之移动。
选择“分布”以获得相等间距或相等中心距，或输入精确间距并应用。

faq.q: 为什么某个编组没有移动？
faq.a: 编组作为一个整体移动。部分选中、隐藏或锁定的编组会被跳过，Mica 会告诉你原因。

faq.q: 可以撤销对齐吗？
faq.a: 可以。每个对齐或分布命令都是一个撤销步骤。

features.why: Lining layers up by hand is slow and never quite exact. Align, Distribute, Center in Parent and the Quick Arrange bar line things up or space them evenly in one step, and each is one undo step.
uses: Line up a row of thumbnails along their tops.
Space five icons with equal gaps between the first and the last.
Center a logo in its frame with ⌥C.
Lay ten screens out in a tidy grid with the Quick Arrange bar.

details.text: Align Left, Align Horizontal Centers, Align Right, Align Top, Align Vertical Centers and Align Bottom. Alignment uses each layer’s visible bounds, including rotation and cropping.
Selection Bounds (default), or a key layer that stays put while the others move. In Design Tools → Align.
With one layer selected, Align works within its parent or Snap To… target. Layers that share a snap target align to that target.
Horizontal Gaps, Vertical Gaps, Horizontal Centers and Vertical Centers. Needs three or more layers. The first and last stay where they are.
In the multi-selection inspector. Type a gap and choose Horizontal or Vertical. Spacing starts at the first layer. Needs two or more layers.

Center Horizontally in Parent (⌥H), Center Vertically in Parent (⌥V) and Center in Parent (⌥C, both axes). In Arrange, Design Tools, the selection menu and Quick Actions. With a snap target set, the command reads Center on Snap Target. These keys never fire while you type in a text field.

Appears above the bottom dock when two or more frames, groups or layers are selected. Row packs blocks left to right with tops aligned. Column stacks them with left edges aligned. Grid uses balanced columns. Spacing: No Gap, 8, 16, 24 or 48, remembered. Hover a button to preview the result.
Complete groups move as one unit. Partly selected, hidden or locked groups are skipped, and Mica tells you why.

tips: Click the layer that is already in the right place to make it the key, then align the rest to it.
Use Distribute for even spacing when the end points are right, and Gap when the spacing value matters.
Group each card before aligning cards, so their contents move together.
Use ⌥C to center inside a frame. Align with one layer selected does the same per edge.

features.title: 创建副本和批量创建副本
features.summary: 原位复制图层，或按精确间距生成整组网格副本。
steps: 选择图层并按 ⌘D，即可原位创建副本。
要创建多个副本，请按 ⌘⇧D，或从所选内容菜单中选择“批量创建副本…”。
设定副本数量，或轻点一个从 2 × 2 到 10 × 10 的方形预设。
选择列数、行数、填充顺序以及水平和垂直间距，然后选择“创建副本”。

faq.q: 副本会保持图层顺序吗？
faq.a: 会。创建副本、粘贴画框和批量创建副本都会精确保持每个图层的堆叠顺序。

faq.q: 最多可以创建多少个副本？
faq.a: 一次最多 500 个，且不超过你方案的项目数量限制。

features.why: Repeating elements is a core design task. Duplicate copies a selection in place, and Multi-Duplicate builds whole grids of copies with exact spacing in one step.
uses: Make a 4 × 3 grid of product cards from one card.
Copy a frame, then use Paste in Place to drop it on another page at the same position.
Lay out ten empty sketch panels in a row with a fixed gap.
Replace a placeholder image with a copied layer using Paste to Replace.

details.text: Copies the selection in place. Copies stack just above their originals in the same order. Layers inside a component instance can’t be duplicated on their own.
In the selection bar, selection menu, touch selection sheet and Quick Actions. The selection’s bounding box is the unit cell, so several layers or a frame copy as one block.
1 to 500. Square presets from 2 × 2 to 10 × 10 count the original as one cell.
Keep Grid Square, or set columns and rows yourself. Fill Rows First or Fill Columns First.
Horizontal and Vertical gaps between copies, in canvas points, up to 2,000. Same Spacing Both Ways links them.
Horizontal: Right → or ← Left. Vertical: Down ↓ or Up ↑. Dashed ghost cells on the canvas preview the grid as you change settings.

details.term: Paste in Place (⌃⌘V) and Paste to Replace (⇧⌘R)
details.text: Paste in Place puts copied layers at the position they were copied from. Paste to Replace swaps the selection for the copied layers, fitted to the replaced bounds and parent, in one undo step. Both work with layers copied in Mica, not content from other apps.
Duplicate, Multi-Duplicate and the paste commands need Mica Pro. Every copy counts toward the board’s item limit, and Multi-Duplicate warns before the grid goes over it.

tips: Group or frame a card before Multi-Duplicate so each copy stays one unit.
Use Fill Columns First when copies will be read top to bottom, such as a storyboard.
After Multi-Duplicate the whole grid stays selected, so you can move or align it at once.
Use Paste to Replace to swap placeholder content without redoing its position and size.

features.title: 页面、图层和视图
features.summary: 将参考板拆分为多个页面，把内容放在不同图层上，并在画布、网格和列表视图之间切换。
steps: 打开左侧边栏中的参考板导航器，然后选择“添加页面”。
拖移页面以重新排序。选择“移到组”可将一个页面嵌套在另一个页面之下。
使用所选内容菜单中的“移到图层”、“移到页面”或“复制到参考板…”来移动内容。
从视图菜单中，将参考板的视图切换为“无限画布”、“网格”或“列表”。

faq.q: 页面可以设为私密吗？
faq.a: 可以。页面和图层都可设为私密；在你解锁 Mica 之前，它们会保持隐藏。

faq.q: 页面组可以嵌套多少层？
faq.a: 一层：一个页面只能位于一个顶层页面之下。

features.why: One canvas gets crowded. Pages split a board into separate canvases, layers keep content apart on each page, and views let you browse the same content as a grid or list.
uses: Keep reference, sketches and final art on separate pages of one board.
Group a set of screenshot pages under one parent page per device.
Bring a finished page from another board in with Import Pages….
Lock a reference page so it can’t be moved by accident.

details.term: Add Page, Paste Page and Import Pages…
details.text: In the Pages section’s ⋯ menu. Import Pages… brings pages in from your other boards and from templates in one undo step, with their backgrounds, grids, locks and privacy.
Each page’s ⋯ menu has Rename…, Lock Page, Hide Page, Customize Grid…, Copy Page, Duplicate Page, Move to Group, Export Page… and Delete Page.
Each page’s ⋯ menu sets what taps and drags do on that page: Edit, Copy or Lock.
Move to Group lists a page under another top-level page. Groups collapse in the navigator. One level deep. Remove from Group moves it back.
From the selection menu: Move to Layer, Move to Page, Move to New Page and Copy to Board….
Canvas, Grid, List, Pages, Layers, Focus and Presentation. Settings → Defaults → Default View sets the view for new boards.
Pages and layers can be private. They stay hidden until you unlock Mica.
The free plan includes one page per board. Extra pages and page settings such as renaming, locking and hiding need Mica Pro.

tips: Set a Default Page in the library so a board opens on the page you use most.
Use Import Pages… instead of copying frames between boards. Styles and fonts come along.
Use layers for parts of one composition and pages for separate compositions.
Hide pages you are not using to keep the navigator short.

hero.alt: A board with pages open in Mica on Apple Vision Pro

features.title: 超级聚焦
features.summary: 只显示一个画框或编组，让你专心处理它，不受页面其他内容干扰。
steps: 选择一个画框或编组。
从右键菜单或所选内容工具中选择“超级聚焦”，或按 ⇧F。在 Mac 上，“视图”菜单中也有此项。
页面上的其他内容都会隐藏，视图会缩放以适合大小。你添加的图层会放入当前聚焦的画框或编组中。
要退出，请选择工具栏中的黄色闪电按钮、按 ⇧F，或在未选择任何内容时按 Esc 键。

faq.q: 超级聚焦会更改参考板的其他部分吗？
faq.a: 不会。其他图层只是被隐藏，退出后视图也会回到原来的位置。

faq.q: 为什么超级聚焦自己结束了？
faq.a: 当聚焦的画框或编组被删除、隐藏或移走，或者你切换页面、开始演示或切换视图模式时，超级聚焦会结束。

features.why: On a busy page, nearby frames get in the way of selecting, snapping and zooming. Hyperfocus hides everything except one frame or group, so selection, guides and new layers all stay inside what you're working on.
uses: Edit one app screen in a flow of dozens without picking neighbors by accident.
Work inside a deeply nested group without clicking out of it.
Present or review one poster on a crowded board without moving it.
Paste or generate content straight into a specific frame.

details.text: Needs exactly one frame or group selected. In the right-click menu, the Mac selection bar, the iPhone and iPad selection tools, the Mac View menu, and ⇧F. Entering clears the selection and zooms to fit.
Everything else on the page is hidden, not dimmed. Selection, Select All, zoom to fit and smart guides only see the focused item. The Layers panel lists only the focused subtree.

Clicks select the focused frame's children directly. Escape and Select Parent never climb above the focused group. New layers, pastes, imports and generator results are placed inside the focused frame or group, and dragging never moves layers out of it.
While on, a yellow bolt button leads the toolbar's trailing section; its help names the focused item. Choose it to exit.
Choose the bolt, press ⇧F, or press Escape when nothing is selected (otherwise Escape steps the selection out first). The view returns to where it was before you entered.

Hyperfocus ends when its frame or group is deleted, hidden, moved to another page or hidden layer, or undone away, when you change page, and when you start Presentation or switch to Grid, List, Pages or Layers view.
Choosing Hyperfocus on another frame or group switches straight to it and keeps the original view to return to.

tips: Press ⇧F to toggle Hyperfocus quickly while you work.
Enter Hyperfocus before pasting so content lands in the right frame.
Use it on a group to edit its children without double-clicking into it each time.
If Hyperfocus ends unexpectedly, check whether the frame was hidden or moved.

features.title: 窗口和程序坞菜单
features.summary: 在单独的窗口中打开参考板；在 Mac 上，还可以从程序坞快速前往已固定、收藏或最近的参考板。
steps: 在素材库中右键点按或长按参考板，然后选择“在新窗口中打开”。如果该参考板已有窗口，Mica 会将其移到最前面。
在 Mac 上，右键点按程序坞中的 Mica，然后从“已固定”、“收藏”或“最近的参考板”下选择一张参考板。按住 Option 键可在新窗口中打开它。
要固定参考板，请在素材库中右键点按它，然后选择“固定到程序坞菜单”。
要重新排列固定项或设定显示的最近参考板数量，请打开“设置”→“通用”→“程序坞菜单”。

faq.q: “清除最近的参考板”会更改我的素材库吗？
faq.a: 不会。它只会让之前打开的参考板不再显示在程序坞菜单中。之后打开的参考板会再次出现。

faq.q: 可以在 iPhone 上用新窗口打开参考板吗？
faq.a: 不可以。“在新窗口中打开”适用于 Mac 和 iPad。

faq.q: 私密参考板会被列出吗？
faq.a: 不会。私密参考板永远不会出现在程序坞菜单中。

features.why: When you compare boards or keep references beside your work, separate windows help. On Mac, the Dock menu gets you to the boards you use most without going back to the library.
uses: Keep a reference board open beside the design board.
Pin active client boards to the Dock menu.
Jump back to a recently opened board from the Dock.
Open two pages of the same project side by side.

details.text: At the top of a board card's menu on Home and in folders, on Mac and iPad (not iPhone). If the board already has a window, that window comes forward. File → New Window still opens the library. Restored windows reopen their board.

Right-click Mica in the Dock: Pinned (your order), Favorites (alphabetical) and Recent Boards (default 8), each board listed once. Hold Option to open the chosen board in a new window. Private boards are never listed.
In a board card's menu on Mac, with Unpin from Dock Menu to remove it. Not shown for private boards.
In the Dock menu and in Settings (with a confirmation). Hides boards opened before now from the Dock menu only; the library's Recent view is unchanged.
A Dock submenu with Show Favorites, Show Recent Boards, Unpin All Boards and Dock Menu Settings….
Show Favorite Boards, Show Recent Boards, Recent Boards Shown (1–15), the pinned list with Move Up, Move Down and Unpin, Clear Recent Boards and Unpin All Boards.
Each window draws at its own display's resolution, so a board stays sharp when a window moves between a Retina and a standard display.

tips: Pin the boards you're actively working on and unpin them when the project ends.
Hold Option in the Dock menu to open a board beside the one you're in.
Lower the recent count if the Dock menu gets long.
Use Clear Recent Boards before a screen share to tidy the Dock menu.

features.title: 撤销、版本和分支
features.summary: 每张参考板最多可撤销 50 步，可保留命名版本，还可以在分支上尝试新想法。
steps: 按 ⌘Z 撤销，按 ⌘⇧Z 重做，或使用工具栏中的“撤销”和“重做”按钮。
从参考板菜单中打开“版本…”，查看关闭参考板时存储的版本。
选择“+”→“存储命名版本”，保留一个永不清理的版本。使用“与当前版本比较”查看更改内容。
选择“+”→“创建分支”，在关联副本上尝试新想法。在分支上，使用“将所有画框合并到源参考板”即可将更改带回。

faq.q: 恢复版本会覆盖我的参考板吗？
faq.a: 不会。恢复总是会创建一张新参考板。

faq.q: 如果存储失败怎么办？
faq.a: Mica 会保留你的编辑内容和撤销记录，并提供“重试存储”以及一个恢复归档。

features.why: Experimenting is safer when you can go back. Undo covers recent edits, versions keep snapshots of whole boards, and branches let you try a bigger idea on a linked copy.
uses: Undo a bad drag or a style change with ⌘Z.
Save a named version before a client review.
Compare today’s board with last week’s version to see which frames changed.
Try an alternative layout on a branch and merge the frames back if it works.

details.text: ⌘Z and ⇧⌘Z, or the toolbar buttons on iPad, wide iPhone and Mac. Each board has its own history of up to 50 steps. The oldest step drops off first, and any new edit clears redo. History lasts for the session and isn’t saved with the board.
From the board menu or the library board menu. Lists versions saved automatically, with their page count, item count and size. Mica keeps the 30 newest automatic versions per board.
Under + in Versions. Give the version a name and a note. Named versions are never pruned. Any automatic version can also be named with Name This Version….
Lists pages added, removed and renamed, frames added, removed and changed, and the change in layer count.
Creates a new board titled with the original name and the version’s date, in the same folder. The current board is untouched.
Under + in Versions. Makes a linked copy that remembers where its pages and frames came from. Counts toward the board and item limits.

details.term: Merge All Frames into Source Board
details.text: On a branch, replaces each frame that came from the source and adds new ones. The source board saves a restorable version first.
If saving fails, Mica keeps your edits and undo history and offers Retry Save and a recovery archive.

tips: Name a version before any big change. Named versions are never pruned.
Use a branch for an alternative direction instead of duplicating the whole board by hand.
Restoring never overwrites, so it is safe to restore just to look at an old state.
Undo is per board. Switching boards never undoes changes on another board.

features.title: 快速操作和快捷键
features.summary: 按名称搜索所有命令并查看其快捷键。如果你更习惯 Figma 的按键，也可以使用它们。
steps: 按 ⌘/ 或 ⌘P 打开“快速操作”。
输入命令名称的一部分，然后按 Return 键运行。不可用的命令会变暗显示。
打开“帮助”→“键盘快捷键”查看完整列表。
要在 Mica 与 Figma 按键不同之处使用 Figma 的按键，请打开“设置”→“画布”→“Figma 键盘快捷键”。

faq.q: 可以自动化操作 Mica 吗？
faq.a: 可以。“快捷指令” App 提供了“将画框添加到 Mica 参考板”、“替换 Mica 参考板中的文本”、“导出 Mica 画框”和“应用 Mica 颜色样式”等操作。

faq.q: 面板处于焦点状态时快捷键还有效吗？
faq.a: 有效。无论焦点在哪里，画布快捷键都有效，除非你正在文本栏中输入。

features.why: Mica has hundreds of commands. Quick Actions finds any of them by name, shows its shortcut, and also searches the Feature Guide, so you don’t have to remember menus or keys.
uses: Type “center” to find Center in Parent and its shortcut.
Insert a frame at an iPhone size by typing “Frame: iPhone”.
Switch to Figma’s keys so your muscle memory works in Mica.
Build your own right-click menu with the ten commands you use most.

details.text: Type words in any order; every word must match. ↑ and ↓ move the highlight and Return runs it. Available commands come first. Dimmed ones need an editable page or a compatible selection. Feature Guide topics come last as Guide: entries.
The full list by group: Selection, Edit, Arrange, View, Tools, Add and Design. Also in Help → Keyboard Shortcuts.

Settings → Canvas. Uses Figma’s keys where Mica’s differ: L line, ⇧L lasso, ⇧H and ⇧V flip, ⇧⌘H show or hide, A and F Frame tool, N and ⇧N next and previous frame, ⌘] and ⌘[ one step forward or back, ⌥⌘] and ⌥⌘[ to front and back. Works on Mac and iPad.
⌥N and ⌥⇧N select and zoom to the next or previous top-level frame in reading order, and wrap around. In Figma mode, N and ⇧N.
⌃⌘] and ⌃⌘[ move a layer one step among its siblings. ⌘] and ⌘[ bring to front and send to back.
⌘E flattens vectors or live booleans. ⌥⇧U, ⌥⇧S, ⌥⇧I and ⌥⇧X apply Union, Subtract, Intersect and Exclude.
F Frame tool, K Scale tool, ⇧⌘K Place Image…, ⌘\ Show / Hide UI.

The capsule at the top of the selection menu switches between Default and your own menus. New Custom Menu… opens a builder: drag actions from the searchable palette onto a grid, reorder or remove them, and turn on Use This Menu. Manage Menus… lets you reorder, delete, import and export menus as JSON files to share.
Actions such as Add Frame to Mica Board, Replace Text in Mica Board, Export Mica Frame and Apply Mica Color Style.

tips: Search Quick Actions with two short words, like “dist gap”, instead of the full name.
Learn a shortcut from the key caps shown beside each result.
Keep a custom right-click menu for each kind of work, such as layout or retouching, and switch with the capsule.
Canvas keys never fire while you type in a text field, so single-letter tools are safe.

features.title: 自定画布菜单
features.summary: 用你最常用的操作构建自己的右键菜单，并通过标签页在菜单之间切换。
steps: 右键点按所选内容，选择菜单顶部的 … 按钮，然后选择“新建自定菜单…”。
将操作从“操作”列表拖到预览网格中。拖移拼贴可重新排序，将拼贴拖回列表即可移除。
设定“名称”、“副标题”、“列”和“显示标签”。要更改拼贴的图标，请选择它，然后选择“更改图标…”。
选择“保存”（⌘S）。打开“使用此菜单”，即可将其设为你的右键菜单。
使用右键菜单顶部的标签页，或在菜单上左右轻扫，即可切换菜单。

faq.q: 可以共享我的菜单吗？
faq.a: 可以。在“菜单”列表中，将一个或所有菜单导出为文件。使用“导入菜单…”可从文件添加菜单。

faq.q: 自定菜单会随参考板一起存储吗？
faq.a: 不会。它们是 App 偏好设置，适用于所有参考板。

faq.q: 为什么某个拼贴变暗了？
faq.a: 该操作不适用于当前所选内容。

features.why: The default right-click menu covers everything, which makes it long. Custom menus put the actions you use most into a compact grid of tiles, and you can keep several for different tasks and switch with a tab or a swipe.
uses: Keep an alignment and distribution menu for layout work.
Build a menu of booleans and vector actions for icon design.
Share a team menu file so everyone has the same quick actions.
Make an icon-only menu with four columns for a compact layout.

details.text: The right-click menu shows Default and each custom menu as tabs at the top. Tap or click a tab, swipe sideways on the menu, scroll sideways with a trackpad on Mac, or use the Left and Right arrow keys. The choice applies everywhere and is remembered.
Next to the selection count: New Custom Menu…, Edit "name"… and Manage Menus….

A searchable list of over 100 menu actions grouped by section, with submenu choices split out (for example Align Left or Center Horizontally). Drag onto an empty slot to append, onto a tile to insert before it, or tap + to add after the selected tile. Each action appears once.

Drag tiles to reorder, or drag one onto the list (Drop to Remove). Select a tile for Change Icon…, Move Earlier (⌘[), Move Later (⌘]) and Remove (⌘⌫). Change Icon… picks any SF Symbol, with Reset to Default.

details.term: Name, Subtitle, Columns and Show Labels
details.text: Columns is 2, 3 (default) or 4. With Show Labels off, tiles show icons only and keep the title as a tooltip and VoiceOver label.
Edits stay in a draft until Save (⌘S). Discard asks first, and Undo (⌘Z) and Redo (⌘⇧Z) cover every studio edit. Use This Menu and the menu list's order, delete and import apply right away.
Select, reorder, Duplicate, Export or Delete menus, Export All Menus… and Import Menus…. Imports skip actions this version doesn't know and say so.
A tile that doesn't apply to the current selection is dimmed and can't be chosen.

tips: Keep a menu to 6–12 tiles so it stays faster than the default menu.
Duplicate a menu before making a variation for another task.
Turn off Show Labels only once you know the icons.
Export your menus before moving to a new device; they're app preferences, not part of a board.

features.title: 查找、替换和拼写检查
features.summary: 在整张参考板中搜索图层名称和文本、替换文本、筛选图层并检查拼写。
steps: 按 ⌘F 打开“查找和替换”。选择“此页面”或“所有页面”，根据需要选择“区分大小写”或“全词匹配”。
使用箭头逐个浏览匹配项；Mica 会切换页面并缩放到每个匹配项。
输入替换文本，然后选择“替换”或“全部替换”。格式会保留。
在“图层”面板中，使用“查找图层”及其筛选菜单按类型或状态缩小范围。
按 ⌘; 检查参考板上所有文本图层的拼写。

faq.q: 私密或锁定的内容会被更改吗？
faq.a: 不会。“查找和替换”会跳过私密和锁定的内容。

faq.q: 可以撤销“全部替换”吗？
faq.a: 可以。“全部替换”是单个撤销步骤。

features.why: On a large board, finding one word or layer by eye is slow. Find and Replace searches text and layer names across pages, and spell check catches typos before you export.
uses: Rename a product across every screen of an App Store set with Replace All.
Find the frame named “Checkout” on a board with dozens of pages.
Show only hidden layers in the Layers panel to clean up a page.
Check spelling in every caption before exporting screenshots.

details.text: Searches text content and layer names. Scope: This Page or All Pages. Options: Match Case and Whole Words.
The arrows step through matches. Mica switches page and zooms to each one.
Rich text keeps each run’s formatting. A match in a layer name renames the layer. Replace All is one undo step. Private and locked content is skipped.

In the Layers panel. Filters by layer name or text content, ignoring case and accents. Results are grouped by layer, front to back. Reordering is off while a search is active. Esc on Mac, or the clear button, resets it.
Narrows Find Layers by type (frames, components and instances, text, shapes and drawings, images, files, links and palettes) and by state (hidden, locked, uses a style, no style).

Lists misspellings in every text layer you can access, using the system spell checker in your preferred language. Each has suggestions, Ignore (for this session) and Learn Spelling. Corrections can be undone.

tips: Turn on Whole Words before Replace All on short words, so you don’t change parts of longer words.
Search All Pages first to see how many matches there are, then replace.
Combine a filter with a search, for example text layers containing “Price”.
Run spell check as the last step before export.

features.title: 画框和分区
features.summary: 画框是拥有独立尺寸、填充和裁剪的容器。画框最多可嵌套八层。分区用于整理参考板，从不裁剪内容。
steps: 在工具栏坞或“添加”菜单中选择“画框”，然后选取尺寸预设或拖出自定画框。
要包裹现有图层，请选择它们并按 ⌥⌘G（“为所选内容添加画框”）。
将图层拖到画框上即可将其放入；蓝色轮廓会显示它们的落点。将图层拖出即可移除。
拖移八个控制点即可调整大小。在角点上按住 Shift 键可保持比例，按住 ⌘ 可仅调整画框本身。
选择“设计工具”→“添加分区”，用分区包裹顶层画框。

faq.q: 如何让画框不裁剪内容？
faq.a: 在检查器的“画框”部分关闭“裁剪内容”。

faq.q: 可以旋转画框吗？
faq.a: 目前还不行。画框始终保持竖直；其中的图层可以旋转。

faq.q: 如何重命名画框？
faq.a: 连按两次画框上方的名称，或在“图层”面板中重命名。

features.why: Frames give a design a fixed size, a background and an edge that clips. Reach for a frame when you build a screen, a card, a slide or an export, and use sections to label and organize groups of frames on a large board.
uses: Lay out an iPhone screen at an exact preset size, then nest cards and buttons inside it.
Crop a photo to a card by dropping it into a frame with Clip Contents on.
Group the screens of one flow in a section named after the flow.
Prepare App Store screenshots at their exact pixel sizes.

details.text: Drag to draw a frame of any size. Hold Shift for a square, or Option to draw from the center. A single click adds a 100 × 100 frame. Dragging inside an existing frame nests the new one in it.

Phone, Tablet, Desktop, Watch, Android, Social Media, Paper and Slides sizes in points, plus App Store Screenshots in pixels. The Landscape toggle turns portrait presets sideways; Social Media formats keep their own orientation. Presets are also in Quick Actions.
Wraps the selected layers in a new frame drawn 32 points outside them. The layers keep their exact positions. They must share the same parent, or have none.
On by default. Hides anything that extends past the frame’s edge, on the canvas and in export. Clipping combines through nested frames. Sections never clip.
Turn it off to make the frame transparent so only its children draw. Turn it back on to get a white fill, then style it in Fill & Stroke.
Turns a frame into an unclipped, labeled section. Add Section wraps the selected top-level frames, or adds an empty 1600 × 1000 section when nothing is selected. Screenshot export skips sections.

details.term: Size Preset, Swap Orientation and Resize to Fit
details.text: Size Preset resizes the selected frame to a preset, keeping its top-left corner. Swap Orientation exchanges width and height. Resize to Fit (⌥⇧⌘R) shrinks or grows the frame to fit its visible children, inner frames first.
Typed values apply when you finish editing and keep the frame’s top-left corner. Frames can be up to 8192 points on a side.
Frames take a uniform or per-corner radius and Figma-style corner smoothing from 0 to 100 %. Children still clip to the square box.
Frames nest up to eight levels. Click a nested frame to select it, double-click or press Return to go inside, and press Esc or ⇧Return to step back out. ⌘-click reaches the deepest layer.

tips: Turn off Fill on wrapper frames that only arrange other layers, so they don’t paint a white box behind them.
Hold ⌘ while you drag a frame handle to change only its boundary and leave the children where they are.
Click a top-level frame’s name above its corner to select it, drag the name to move it, and double-click to rename it.
A frame’s opacity affects its fill only. Hide or lock the frame to affect everything inside.
Press ⇧F to Hyperfocus on the selected frame and hide everything else on the page while you work on it.
Frames can’t be rotated or grouped. Put groups inside frames instead.

features.title: 编组
features.summary: 将图层编组后，可以一起移动、隐藏、锁定和淡化它们。编组可以包含其他编组。
steps: 选择图层并按 ⌘G 进行编组。按 ⌘⇧G 取消编组。
连按两次编组可选择其中的图层。使用“选择父级编组”或“选择子级编组”在各层级之间移动。
在“图层”面板或检查器中重命名编组。
设定编组的不透明度：编组会作为一个拼合后的图层整体淡化，因此重叠部分不会透出。

faq.q: 取消编组时，锁定的图层会怎样？
faq.a: 取消编组会保留每个图层各自的锁定和可见性状态。

faq.q: 编组可以包含画框吗？
faq.a: 不可以。编组可以位于画框内，但画框不能被编组。

features.why: Groups keep related layers together so you can move, hide, lock and fade them as one, without the clipping and fixed size of a frame. Use a group for a logo lockup, an icon made of several shapes, or any cluster you keep moving together.
uses: Group the shapes of an icon so it moves and scales as one piece.
Fade a whole illustration with one group opacity value.
Lock a finished cluster so stray clicks can’t move its parts.
Wrap a shape and a photo in a group and turn the bottom layer into a mask.

details.text: Group wraps the selected sibling layers without flattening groups already inside. Ungroup removes only the selected level and keeps each child’s own lock and visibility.
Groups can contain groups up to 32 levels deep. A group can live inside a frame, but a frame can’t be put in a group.
Click selects the group. Double-click, or press Return, goes down one level; ⇧Return selects the parent. ⌘-click selects a layer deep inside without entering each level.
Rename in the Group section of the inspector or from the Layers row. Unnamed groups show Group, or Mask Group when their bottom child is a mask. Locked groups can still be renamed.

A slider from 0 to 100 %. Below 100 % the group is drawn once as a flattened layer, so overlapping children don’t show through each other. The same result appears on the canvas and in PNG, PDF and SVG export. Child opacity values are not changed.

Toggles in the inspector and the eye and lock buttons on the Layers row. Hiding a group hides every descendant but keeps each child’s own hidden state, so showing the group restores them exactly. A locked group blocks edits to its members and ungrouping.
In the Group section, makes the whole group the mask for the layers above it in the same container, with a Mask Type of Alpha, Vector or Luminance.

tips: Use group opacity instead of lowering each child’s opacity when you want a clean, even fade.
Name groups as soon as you make them; names show in the Layers panel, in Rename Layers and in exports.
Groups don’t count against the free plan’s item allowance.
Press ⇧F with a group selected to Hyperfocus on it and hide the rest of the page.

features.title: 蒙版
features.summary: 使用形状、编组或画框，仅显示其上方图层的一部分。
steps: 将蒙版形状放在要遮罩的图层下方，然后全部选中。
按 ⌃⌘M 或选择“用作蒙版”。
在检查器中选择蒙版类型：“Alpha”使用形状的透明度，“矢量”使用其轮廓，“明度”使用其亮度。
选择蒙版即可移动或改变其形状；被遮罩的内容会实时更新。

faq.q: 可以制作柔边蒙版吗？
faq.a: 可以。使用渐变或模糊形状，并搭配“Alpha”或“明度”类型。

faq.q: 如何移除蒙版？
faq.a: 选择蒙版并关闭“用作蒙版”，或取消被遮罩编组的编组。

features.why: A mask shows the layers above it only where the mask has content. Use it to put a photo inside a shape, fill lettering with an image, or fade a layer out with a gradient, without editing the original.
uses: Put a portrait inside a circle or a star.
Fill large headline text with a photo.
Fade the bottom of an image to transparent with a gradient luminance mask.
Clip a whole frame of content to an organic blob shape.

details.text: With one layer selected, turns it into a mask in place. With several sibling layers selected, wraps them in a new group whose bottom-most layer becomes the mask, in one undo step. Also in the context menu, selection bar and inspector.
Every layer above it in the same container: its group, its frame or the layer root, including nested groups and frames. Masks in nested groups combine with outer masks.
The default. Uses the mask’s transparency, so soft edges and fading gradients give soft results.
Uses the outline. Closed shapes count as fully filled, text keeps its letter shapes, and other layers use their box.
Uses brightness: white shows content, black hides it, and grays show it partly.
A selected group or frame can be the mask. A group masks with its whole contents; a frame masks with its fill and contents.
The mask itself isn’t drawn. Hiding the mask stops it masking. The mask’s opacity counts, so a 50 % mask shows its content at 50 %.
Masks show a half-filled circle and masked rows show an arrow. Clicks outside the mask’s shape fall through to the layers below.

tips: Put the mask at the bottom: it only clips layers above it in the same group or frame.
Use Alpha with a gradient fill that fades to transparent for a soft edge; use Vector when you want a crisp outline whatever the fill.
To round an image’s corners, use the Corner Radius fields in its Crop section instead of a mask.
Soft masks export exactly in PNG, PDF and SVG.

features.title: “图层”面板
features.summary: 按堆叠顺序查看每个图层，重新排序，以及隐藏或锁定图层。
steps: 打开左侧边栏中的“图层”。画框和编组会显示展开箭头；嵌套层级会缩进显示。
拖移行的把手即可重新排序。将其放到另一个画框中的行旁边，即可将其移入该画框。
使用右侧边缘的眼睛和锁按钮隐藏或锁定图层。
右键点按行即可打开其菜单：重命名、创建副本、用 AI 重命名等。
嵌套较深时，行可左右滚动；在画布上选择图层时，其所在行会自动滚动到可见位置。

faq.q: 图层图标上的数字代表什么？
faq.a: 表示该图层上效果工作室效果的数量。

faq.q: 翻转的图标是什么意思？
faq.a: 该行是一个镜像图层，显示的是另一个图层的内容。

features.why: The Layers panel shows everything on the page in stacking order, so you can find, reorder, hide and lock layers that are hard to reach on the canvas. Board layers sit at the top level; frames, groups and items nest under them.
uses: Pick a small layer that is buried under others.
Drag a layer above or below another to change what draws on top.
Hide a reference layer while you work, then show it again.
Find every hidden or unstyled layer with Find Layers and its filters.

details.text: Open Layers from the left sidebar rail. On iPhone, Layers opens as a compact sheet.

On Mac, drag a row from anywhere on it, including the name. On iPhone, iPad and Vision Pro, drag by the grip so touch drags still scroll the list. Locked or read-only rows can’t be dragged. Reordering is off while a search is active.
Pinned at the right edge of each row, even when the list scrolls sideways. They show or hide and lock or unlock a layer, group or board layer.

Right-click, Control-click or long-press a row to open the selection menu next to the row. It includes Rename…, Arrange, Zoom to Selection and Rename with AI. A row outside the selection is selected first.
Zoom to Layer, Rename…, Move Selection Here, Opacity (100, 75, 50 or 25 %), Make Private or Remove Private, and Delete Layer. The + button adds a board layer. A page always keeps at least one layer.
Filters rows by layer name or text content, ignoring case and accents. Results are grouped by board layer, front to back. Press Esc on Mac or the clear button to reset.

Type: Frames, Components and Instances, Text, Shapes and Drawings, Images, Files, Links and Palettes. State: Hidden, Locked, Uses a Style, No Style. Filters combine with the search text. Clear Filters resets them.
A number on a layer icon counts its Effect Studio effects. A flipped icon marks a mirror layer. Masks show a half-filled circle. A spinner or faint sparkle marks layers being renamed with AI.
Names end in an ellipsis before the lock and eye buttons. Rows scroll sideways only when nesting is deep, and selecting a layer on the canvas scrolls its row into view.

tips: Collapse finished frames and groups with their disclosure arrow to keep long pages readable.
Use separate board layers for references and design work, then lock or hide the reference layer as a whole.
Filter by Hidden before exporting to catch layers you forgot to show again.
Use Zoom to Layer at the top of a board layer’s menu to frame everything on it.

hero.alt: The Layers panel on iPad listing frames, text and groups

features.title: 约束
features.summary: 约束决定了调整画框大小时，画框内的图层如何移动或拉伸。
steps: 选择画框内的一个图层。
在检查器的“约束”部分选择水平规则：“左”、“右”、“左和右”、“居中”或“缩放”。
选择垂直规则：“上”、“下”、“上和下”、“居中”或“缩放”。
调整画框大小。图层会实时遵循其规则；按住 ⌘ 可在调整画框大小时不应用约束。

faq.q: 默认设置是什么？
faq.a: 左和上：图层与画框左上角的距离保持不变。

faq.q: 约束对旋转的图层有效吗？
faq.a: 旋转的图层会按约束移动，但不会拉伸。

features.why: Constraints tell each layer in a frame what to do when the frame changes size: stay pinned to an edge, stretch, stay centered or scale. Set them once and you can resize a screen from phone to tablet without moving everything by hand.
uses: Keep a close button in the top-right corner of any screen width.
Stretch a header bar edge to edge when the screen gets wider.
Keep a logo centered as a card grows.
Scale a background illustration with its frame.

details.text: Left (default), Right, Left & Right, Center or Scale. Left and Right keep the distance to that edge. Left & Right keeps both distances, so the layer stretches. Center keeps the offset from the frame’s center. Scale changes position and size in proportion.
Top (default), Bottom, Top & Bottom, Center or Scale, with the same meanings.
When you resize the frame with its handles, its Width and Height fields, Super Layout hug and fill, or a component instance.
While you drag a frame handle, its contents follow their constraints on the canvas. Nothing is saved until you release, and the whole resize is one undo step.
Hold ⌘ while you drag a frame handle to resize only the frame boundary.
A child frame that stretches applies its own children’s constraints in turn.
Rotated layers keep their size and only move.

tips: Set constraints before you duplicate a screen for another device size.
For full-width bars and dividers, use Left & Right so they always reach both edges.
Children of a Super Layout frame use Fill and Fixed sizing instead; constraints apply to its absolute-position children.
Typed Width and Height changes keep the frame’s top-left corner, so pin layers to the right or bottom when they should follow those edges.

features.title: 批量重命名图层
features.summary: 使用模式、编号以及查找和替换，一次重命名多个图层。
steps: 选择图层并按 ⌘R。
输入模式。$& 表示当前名称；$n、$nn 和 $nnn 会添加编号。
设定起始编号和顺序，或对现有名称使用“查找和替换”。
检查实时预览，然后选择“重命名”。

faq.q: Mica 可以帮我为图层命名吗？
faq.a: 可以。使用“用 AI 重命名”，根据图层内容为其命名。

faq.q: 重命名可以撤销吗？
faq.a: 可以，一步即可撤销。

features.why: Clear layer names make the Layers panel, Find Layers, exports and handoff easier to read. Batch rename fixes dozens of names at once instead of one row at a time.
uses: Number a set of screens Screen 01, Screen 02 and so on.
Add a prefix to a set of icons, such as icon/star.
Replace Draft with Final in every selected name.
Give exported files predictable names.

details.text: Opens the rename sheet for the selected layers. Also in Design Tools. With one layer selected, Rename To starts with its current name.
The new name pattern. $& inserts the current name. $n, $nn and $nnn insert a number padded to one, two or three digits: 1, 01, 001. Leave it empty to only find and replace.
The first number, from 0 to 9999. Default 1.
Ascending or Descending. Numbering follows the Layers order from top to bottom.
Find and Replace With change matching text inside each name. Matching is case-sensitive. Find and replace runs first, then the Rename To pattern.
Shows each old name and its new name before you choose Rename. Names are limited to 200 characters.
Renaming works on locked layers, as in Figma. The whole rename is one undo step.

tips: Use $& with a prefix or suffix, such as icon/$&, to keep each layer’s own name.
Reorder layers in the Layers panel first; numbers follow that order.
Use slashes in names (Button / Primary) to keep related layers easy to find in search.
Rename with AI names layers from their content and is part of Mica Pro. Its length, format and naming rules are in Settings.

features.title: 添加和编辑文本
features.summary: 在任意缩放比例或旋转角度下直接在画布上输入。无需单独的编辑器表单。
steps: 按 T，然后点按以开始“自动宽度”文本，或拖移以绘制“固定大小”文本框。在 iPhone 和 iPad 上，轻点“文本”。
开始输入。编辑时仅显示一条细轮廓线。
连按两次任意文本图层即可编辑；插入点会位于你点按的位置。
按 Esc 键、⌘Return 或点按其他位置即可完成。整个编辑过程是一个撤销步骤。
完成时，空白文本会自动移除。

faq.q: 如何编辑便签？
faq.a: 连按两次便签。便签可像文本一样原位编辑。

faq.q: 为什么缩小视图时新文本会更大？
faq.a: Mica 会调整新文本的大小，使其在屏幕上以相同大小显示，方便你看清输入的内容。

features.why: Text is edited right where it sits on the canvas, at the zoom and rotation you see, so you judge size and spacing in context. There is no separate editor to open and close.
uses: Label a moodboard with short captions.
Write headlines and body copy for a screen design.
Fix a typo in a rotated title without straightening it first.
Add notes to a reference with a sticky note.

details.text: Press T, then click to start Auto Width text, or drag to draw a Fixed Size box. The Mac dock button works the same. On iPhone and iPad, the Text button places text at the center of the view and starts editing.
Double-click a text layer to edit; the caret lands where you clicked. On Mac, Return on a selected text layer also starts editing.
Esc, ⌘Return, clicking away or selecting something else finishes and keeps every keystroke. On touch, a long press off the text also finishes. The whole session is one undo step.
A click inside the box moves the caret, even in its empty part. Clicks outside finish editing.
New text starts empty. If it’s still empty when you finish, the layer removes itself.
New text is sized to read at the same size on screen, so it stays legible when you place it zoomed out.
Double-click a sticky note to edit it in place over its card. Stickies grow to keep their text on the card.

tips: Click for labels and short lines; drag a box for paragraphs that should wrap.
Type in a Typography field and press Return to go straight back to the text.
Use Find and Replace (⌘F) to change the same words across many text layers.

features.title: 在一个文本图层中混合样式
features.summary: 为任意单词或字母单独设定字体、字号、颜色、间距和大小写，全部在同一个图层中完成。
steps: 连按两次文本，然后选择要设定样式的字符。
在“排版”中更改字体、样式、字号、颜色或字距。只有所选字符会更改。
没有检查器时，使用底部的格式栏：字体、样式、字号、斜体、下划线、删除线、颜色和对齐方式。
选中整个图层时，若各段文字设置不同，“排版”会显示“混合”；所做的编辑会应用到全部文字。
编辑时按 ⌘⇧> 或 ⌘⇧< 可逐级调整字号。

faq.q: 为什么不能为每个单词设定行高？
faq.a: 行高、对齐方式和段落间距按段落应用。

faq.q: 其他 App 会保留样式吗？
faq.a: 将文本拷贝到其他 App 时会发送富文本。存储、创建副本或导出 .refboard 时，Mica 会保留所有样式。

features.why: One text layer can mix fonts, sizes, colors and spacing, so a headline with a highlighted word or a price with a smaller currency sign stays a single layer. That keeps layout, alignment and export simple.
uses: Set one word of a headline in a different color or weight.
Make a price with a smaller, raised currency sign.
Combine an uppercase eyebrow label and a title in one layer.
Strike through an old price next to a new one.

details.text: With the layer selected, Typography shows every run, with Mixed where they differ, and edits all of it. While editing, it shows and edits only the selected characters. At a bare caret it sets the style of the next characters you type.
Font, style, size, color or gradient fill, letter spacing, case, underline and strikethrough.
Line height, alignment and paragraph spacing apply to whole paragraphs.
From 1 to 4096 points.
Line height from 50 to 500 % of the font’s natural line height. Letter spacing from −50 to 100 % of the font size, so it follows size changes.
Extra points after each paragraph, from 0 to 400.
Original, Uppercase, Lowercase, Title Case or Small Caps. Small Caps needs a font that includes them.
Up and Down step a number field by 1, Shift by 10. Steps are relative to each run, so a 34/44/72 selection becomes 35/45/73. While editing, ⌘⇧> and ⌘⇧< step the size.
When no inspector is showing, a bar along the bottom holds font, style, size, italic, underline, strikethrough, color, alignment and Done. On iPhone it replaces the bottom sheet while you edit.

tips: Style a whole layer first, then select single words for the exceptions.
Typing takes the style of the character before the caret; place the caret after the style you want to continue.
Mixed counts as off for italic, underline and strikethrough, so the first press turns the style on for every run.
Copying text into other apps sends rich text; .refboard export, duplication and saving keep every style.

features.title: 文本框大小与适配
features.summary: 选择文本框的扩展方式：“自动宽度”、“自动高度”、“固定大小”或“随框缩放”。“适配”会缩放文字以填满文本框。
steps: 选择一个文本图层，然后打开“排版”。
选择“自动宽度”以横向扩展，“自动高度”以在固定宽度处换行，或“固定大小”以保持文本框不变。
设定水平对齐（左对齐、居中、右对齐、两端对齐）和垂直对齐（顶部、中部、底部）。
要让文本填满文本框，请选择一个“适配”选项：“框宽度”、“框高度”或“宽度和高度”。
使用“高度适合文本”，使文本框高度贴合文本行。

faq.q: 我的文本超出了“固定大小”文本框。
faq.a: “固定大小”会保持文本框不变，并让文本可见地溢出。切换到“自动高度”可让文本框随之扩展。

faq.q: “适配”会更改字号吗？
faq.a: 不会。它缩放的是绘制效果，因此字号保持你设定的值。

features.why: The resizing mode decides what the box does when the text or the box changes. Picking the right one keeps labels hugging their text, paragraphs wrapping at a set width, and buttons in a Super Layout resizing themselves.
uses: Make a button label that grows as you type (Auto Width).
Wrap a paragraph at a fixed column width (Auto Height).
Keep a text box at a set size for a template (Fixed Size).
Scale a big display word to exactly fill a poster area (Fit).

details.text: The box widens to fit the longest line. Lines break only where you press Return. It grows from its aligned edge: left text grows right, centered text grows both ways.
The width stays fixed and the box grows or shrinks downward to fit every line.
The box keeps its size. Resizing rewraps the text without changing the font size. Text that doesn’t fit overflows visibly, away from the vertical alignment, on the canvas and in export.
Mica’s classic behavior for older boards: resizing the box scales the text like an image. Switching away from it freezes the current size, so nothing changes visually.
Dragging a side handle of Auto Width text switches it to Auto Height; dragging a top or bottom handle switches it to Fixed Size.
Left, center, right or justify, side by side with top, middle or bottom. Vertical alignment applies to the whole layer.

None, Box Width, Box Height, Width and Height Uniform, or Width and Height Stretch. Fit scales the drawing, not the font size, and measures the letter shapes so capitals reach the edges. It follows the box as you resize. Choosing Fit fixes the box; choosing an auto mode clears Fit.
In Design Tools. Snaps the height of Fixed Size, Scale with Box and sticky note boxes to their lines without changing the width.

tips: Use Auto Width or Auto Height inside Super Layout so buttons and cards resize with their text.
Use Box Width or Box Height Fit for display type; it can overflow the other dimension, and alignment places the leftover space.
Width and Height Stretch can distort letters. Use Uniform unless you want that effect.
If text spills out of a Fixed Size box, switch to Auto Height or enlarge the box.

features.title: 渐变文本和彩色文本
features.summary: 为任意字符填充纯色，或线性、径向、角度或菱形渐变。
steps: 在编辑时选择字符，或选择整个文本图层。
点按“排版”或格式栏中的填充色块。
选择一种填充类型，选取一个渐变预设，然后调整角度和色标。
选择纯色即可替换渐变。

faq.q: 渐变会覆盖整个图层吗？
faq.a: 渐变覆盖你所应用的字符，即使跨越换行也是如此。

faq.q: 下划线会应用渐变吗？
faq.a: 目前还不会。渐变字符上不会绘制下划线和删除线。

features.why: Text fills let any characters take a gradient instead of a flat color, for headlines and accents that would otherwise need an image. The gradient stays live, so you can still edit the words.
uses: Give one word of a headline a gradient and keep the rest solid.
Make a logotype with an angular or diamond gradient.
Match lettering colors to a palette with one of the presets.
Change a gradient title back to a brand color in one step.

details.text: In Typography and the format bar. It shows the current color, the gradient type or Mixed. With characters selected it styles them; otherwise it styles the whole layer.
Solid, Linear, Radial, Angular or Diamond.
Eight presets to start from.
Set the angle, drag stops along the gradient bar, click the bar to add a stop, and set each stop’s color, position and opacity. Reverse flips the stops.
A gradient spans the characters it was applied to, not the whole box, even across wrapped lines.
The layer’s Fill & Stroke section still holds stacked paints, noise and blending for the whole text layer. Text doesn’t take image fills.
Underline and strikethrough aren’t drawn on gradient characters. Color emoji in a gradient range have no outline to fill. Other apps and older Mica versions get one stand-in color.

tips: Apply the gradient to the word you want it across; applying it to the whole layer stretches it over every line.
Choose a solid color to replace a gradient on the selected characters.
Gradients show live while you edit, so you can adjust stops and see the result in place.

features.title: 字体和排版功能
features.summary: 使用任意已安装的字体、可变字体轴和 OpenType 功能。字体会随参考板一同保存。
steps: 选择文本，然后在“排版”中打开字体选取器，选择任意已安装的字体系列和样式。
对于可变字体，使用滑块调整字重或字宽等轴。
打开 OpenType 功能，例如小型大写字母、等宽数字或替代字形。
将“渲染”设为“平滑”（默认）或“锐利”以获得硬朗的像素边缘。

faq.q: 我的参考板在其他设备上会正确显示吗？
faq.a: 会。参考板中使用的字体会嵌入其中，并在打开时注册。

faq.q: 为什么放大后文本看起来较模糊？
faq.a: 文本会随着缩放变得清晰；“随框缩放”文本则保持固定分辨率。

features.why: Mica uses the fonts installed on your device, plus font files you add to a board or your Font Library. Embedded fonts travel with the board, so it looks the same on your other devices and for anyone who opens a .refboard.
uses: Set a brand typeface on a board and keep it on every device.
Use tabular numbers for prices and tables so digits line up.
Fine-tune weight and width on a variable font.
Turn off antialiasing for pixel fonts with Sharp rendering.

details.text: Searchable, with each family previewed in its own face. Sections: In This Board, Font Library and All Fonts.

Embeds .ttf, .otf, .ttc or .otc files in the board. You can also drop font files on the canvas. Up to 40 MB per file and 64 faces per board. Remove from Board takes a family out again. Both are undoable.

The Fonts screen in the library sidebar (on iPhone, a page of the Assets tab) imports many fonts or whole folders at once, up to 2,000 files per import. Picking a library family in a board embeds that family in the board.
A slider for each axis of the first selected layer’s font, such as weight, width or optical size. Reset Axes returns them to the font’s defaults.

Ligatures, Kerning, Discretionary Ligatures, Tabular, Proportional, Old-Style and Lining Numbers, Fractions, Slashed Zero, Small Caps, Capitals to Small Caps, Case-Sensitive Forms, Superscript, Subscript, Stylistic Alternates and Stylistic Sets 1–5. The list shows what the font supports when it reports that.
Smooth (default) gives antialiased edges. Sharp turns antialiasing off for hard pixel edges, on the canvas and in export.
Fonts register for Mica only, never system-wide. On a device without a family that isn’t embedded, text falls back to the system font.

tips: Embed any font that isn’t a system font before you share or export a board.
Use Tabular Numbers for columns of figures and Case-Sensitive Forms for all-caps headings.
Check the license before you embed a font in a board you share.
Features that change the number of glyphs, such as ligatures, appear after you finish editing.

features.title: 形状
features.summary: 绘制矩形、椭圆、三角形、多边形、星形和线条，然后编辑其圆角、填充和描边。
steps: 从“形状”菜单或 Pencil 调板中选择一种形状，然后在画布上拖移。
按住 Shift 键可保持等比例，按住 Option 键可从中心开始绘制。
在检查器中设定圆角半径；调整大小时它会保持不变。
需要编辑锚点时，请使用“转换为路径”。

faq.q: 为什么我新建的形状没有轮廓线？
faq.a: 新的填充形状默认没有描边。在工具选项中打开“描边”，或在“填充与描边”中添加描边。

faq.q: 可以编辑描边的虚线和端点吗？
faq.a: 可以。描边选项包括位置、端点、拐角和虚线。

features.why: Shapes are the basic vector building blocks for icons, buttons, cards and diagrams. They keep their parameters, such as corner radius, side count and arc, so you can change them later instead of redrawing.
uses: Draw a rounded button background with iOS-style smooth corners.
Make a pie chart slice or a progress ring from an oval.
Draw a hexagon badge with a polygon and adjust its sides.
Add dashed outlines to mark areas on a wireframe.

details.text: Rectangle R, Oval O, Star S, Triangle ⇧R, Polygon ⇧O, Line ⇧L, Pen P. Hold Shift for equal proportions or 45° angles, and Option to draw from the center.

One radius for every corner, or separate top-left, top-right, bottom-right and bottom-left values. Radii stay the same when you resize, and overlapping radii shrink together so they stay inside the box. Frames take corner radii too.
Figma-style continuous corners from 0 to 100 % on rectangles and frames. The iOS button sets 60 %.

details.term: Oval: Arc Start, Arc Sweep and Ratio
details.text: Start and sweep from 0 to 360° make pies and arcs. Ratio from 0 to 99 % cuts a hole for rings.
From 3 to 60, with a corner radius. The Triangle and Polygon tools both draw polygons.
Drag the handles on a selected shape to change its radius, side count, arc or ring ratio directly.

New filled shapes start without a stroke; turn on Stroke in the tool options. Stroke Position (Center, Inside, Outside), Cap (Flat, Round, Square), Join (Miter, Round, Bevel) and Dashed with Dash Length and Dash Gap.

In the inspector and the right-click menu, for rectangles, ovals, triangles, polygons, stars, blobs, arrows and older closed shapes. Opens the result in point editing; fill, stroke and effects are kept. One undo step.

tips: Keep shapes as shapes as long as you can; convert to a path only when you need to move individual points.
Use Inside stroke position on buttons and cards so the outline doesn’t grow the shape.
Use 60 % Corner Smoothing for app icons and iOS-style controls.
Use the Scale tool (K) when you want strokes, radii and shadows to scale with the shape.

features.title: 生成器
features.summary: 在设备上生成占位文本、波浪、二维码、配色、图表和弧形文字，并作为普通的可编辑图层添加。
steps: 打开“快速操作”并选择“生成器”，或选择“设计工具”→“插入”。在 Mac 上，也可以选择“插入”→“生成器…”。
选取一个标签页：“内容”、“波浪”、“二维码”、“调色板”、“图表”或“弧形文字”。更改设置时，预览会随之更新。
在“内容”标签页中，选择一种类型，如“Lorem 句子”、“全名”或“电子邮件”。选中文本图层时，“填充文本”会为每个图层填入不同的值；否则，“添加文本”会添加一个新图层。
在其他标签页中，选择“插入”。结果会出现在视图中央并处于选中状态，可一步撤销。

faq.q: 以后还能把弧形文字当作文本编辑吗？
faq.a: 不能。它会作为一个填充的矢量形状插入。请在生成器中修改文字后重新插入。

faq.q: 如何在两个图层之间画箭头？
faq.a: 恰好选择两个图层，然后选择“用箭头连接”，或按 ⌃⌥A。移动图层时，箭头不会跟随。

faq.q: 生成器需要联网吗？
faq.a: 不需要。所有内容都在你的设备上生成。

features.why: Generators replace a handful of popular design plugins with built-in tools. They run on your device, need no account or connection, and make ordinary layers you can keep editing.
uses: Fill a UI mockup's text layers with realistic names, emails and prices in one step.
Add a scannable QR code to a poster or slide.
Build a quick color harmony from one brand color.
Sketch a bar or donut chart shape for a dashboard mockup.

details.text: Opened from Quick Actions, Design Tools → Insert, or Insert → Generators… on Mac. Tabs: Content, Blobs, Stars, Waves, QR Code, Palette, Chart and Arc Text; Blobs and Stars open their own studios. Results land at the center of the view, selected, in one undo step.

17 types: Lorem Words, Lorem Sentence, Lorem Paragraph, Full Name, First Name, Email, Phone Number, Company, Job Title, City, Date, Time, Price, Percentage, Whole Number, Username and Web Address. Fill Text gives each selected text or sticky layer a different value and keeps its formatting; with nothing selected, Add Text adds a new text layer. Shuffle picks new values. Emails and phone numbers are fictional.
Smooth, Peaks or Stepped style, Width, Height, 1–5 Bands, Wave Count (1–24), Amplitude and Color. Back bands sit higher and lighter; the front band uses the chosen color.
Link or Text up to 1,200 bytes, Error Correction (Low, Medium, Quartile, High), Color, Size and an optional White Quiet Zone. Inserted as a vector drawing.

A Base Color plus a Harmony: Complementary, Analogous, Triadic, Split Complementary, Tetradic, Monochromatic or Shades. Adds one palette card per color, selected together. Palette generation needs Mica Pro.

Vertical Bars, Horizontal Bars, Line, Area, Pie or Donut from typed Data Values separated by commas, spaces or lines (up to 48; invalid numbers are skipped). Colors follow the chosen color. Shapes only, with no text labels.
Text, Weight, Color, Size, Letter Spacing and Bend from −100% to +100%; a full bend wraps the text into a circle. Inserted as one filled vector, not editable text.

With exactly two layers selected: Quick Actions, Design Tools → Insert, Insert on Mac, or ⌃⌥A. Draws an editable arrow between their edges with an 8 pt gap. It doesn't follow the layers when they move.

tips: Select all the text layers in a list before choosing Fill Text so each gets a different value.
Keep strong contrast and the White Quiet Zone on QR codes so cameras can scan them.
Type your arc text carefully; once inserted it is a shape, so fix typos in the generator.
Recolor waves and charts later with the ordinary fill controls.
Use Shuffle to try new variations before inserting.

features.title: 斑点形状和星形
features.summary: 生成有机的斑点形状和星形，插入后仍可继续编辑。
steps: 打开工具栏坞中的“形状”菜单，然后选择“斑点形状…”或“星形…”。也可以在“设计工具”→“插入”中找到它们。
在“斑点形状”中，选择一种样式，如“有机”、“云朵”、“黏液”或“圆环”，然后调整该样式的控制项、“随机度”、“旋转”和“对称”。选择“随机排列”可获得新的变化。
在“星形”中，选择一个预设，如“经典星形”或“闪光”，或者设定“点数”、“内半径”和“圆润度”。
选择“填充”或“描边”以及颜色。对于斑点形状，设定“数量”和“排列”，一次最多可插入 24 个。
选择“插入”。之后选择斑点形状或星形，即可在检查器的“斑点形状”或“星形”部分中编辑它。

faq.q: 可以手动移动锚点吗？
faq.a: 可以。在右键菜单或检查器中选择“转换为路径”。轮廓保持不变，但斑点形状或星形的控制项会被移除。

faq.q: 调整斑点形状的大小会让它复位吗？
faq.a: 不会。斑点形状会在新的大小内重新绘制，之后再调整时也会保持该大小。

features.why: Blobs and Stars generate decorative shapes that would take a long time to draw by hand. Unlike flat imports, each one keeps its settings, so you can restyle, reshuffle or resize it after it's on the board.
uses: Add organic background shapes behind a poster headline or app screenshot.
Scatter a cluster of blobs as a pattern for a social graphic.
Make sale badges, sparkles and starbursts for marketing layouts.
Start a logo from a star or blob, then convert it to a path and refine it.

details.text: In the tool dock's Shapes menu, Design Tools → Insert, the Generators sheet and Insert → Blobs… on Mac. Eleven styles: Organic, Wobbly Circle, Splash, Cloud, Star Blob, Squiggle Ribbon, Pebble, Goo, Gradient Blob, Burst and Ring, each with its own controls.
Shared blob controls. Randomness scales every style's irregularity; Symmetry is None, Mirror or 2-, 3-, 4-, 5-, 6- or 8-Fold. Shuffle picks a new seed.
Insert 1–24 blobs at once in a Scatter, Row or Grid, with Spacing and Size Variance. Each blob gets its own seed. On the free plan the whole count must fit the item allowance.

In the Shapes menu, Design Tools → Insert and Insert → Stars… on Mac. Presets: Classic Star, Sparkle, Badge, Burst and Soft Star. Points run from 3 to 50, plus Inner Radius, Roundness, Rotation and Size.
Filled or Outlined (with Outline Width) and a color. Gradient Blob fills with one of its gradient presets.

Select an inserted blob or star to change its style, controls or seed in the inspector. Resizing, moving and duplicating keep working, and a resize sticks through later tweaks. Each slider drag is one undo step.
From the right-click menu or the inspector, for blobs, stars and other shapes. The result opens in point editing; fill, stroke and effects are kept, but the generator controls are removed.

tips: Use Symmetry for logo-like marks and leave it at None for natural shapes.
Lower Randomness for calmer shapes behind text.
Use Size Variance with Scatter so clusters don't look repeated.
Convert to Path only when you need to move individual points; you lose the generator controls.
Try the Soft Star preset for friendly badges and Burst for sale tags.

features.title: 钢笔与矢量编辑
features.summary: 绘制贝塞尔路径、编辑其锚点和控制柄、轮廓化描边以及合并形状。
steps: 选择钢笔工具。点按可添加角点，拖移可添加平滑点。点按第一个锚点即可闭合路径。
选择一条路径并按 Return 键以编辑其锚点。拖移锚点和控制柄；连按两次锚点可在角点和平滑点之间切换。
按 ⌥⌘O 可将描边转换为填充形状（“轮廓化描边”）。
在重叠的形状上选择“矢量”→“形状生成器”，然后拖过各个区域以将其合并。

faq.q: 可以平滑手绘线条吗？
faq.a: 可以。选择“转换为平滑路径”。

faq.q: 如何制作渐细描边？
faq.a: 应用“宽度配置文件”；它会变成可编辑的轮廓。
